title: Esri 3D Buildings
description:
The Esri 3D Buildings scene layer includes commercial 3D buildings data acquired from TomTom and Vantor, in addition to Esri Community Maps and Overture Maps Foundation data. The Esri 3D Buildings scene layer is intended as an alternative to the OpenStreetMap (OSM) 3D Buildings scene layer, particularly for areas where the OSM data is missing accurate 3D attributes.
 
The scene layer currently has global coverage but future releases will include additional commercial and community data to improve the overall quality.
 
The scene layer include tens of millions of multi-part buildings with more accurate 3D attributes, which supports better visualization and client-side analysis. You can compare the OSM and Esri 3D buildings for several locations using this compare web app.
